data.title: What [[Claude]] is, in plain words
data.subtitle: Four facts to know before you type anything.

facets.label: IN PLAIN ENGLISH
facets.text: Anthropic, an AI company that calls itself a public benefit corporation.

facets.label: ITS STATED MISSION
facets.text: Responsible development of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity.

facets.label: IN PLAIN ENGLISH
facets.text: A large language model, trained to be helpful, honest and harmless.

facets.label: HOW IT FEELS
facets.text: A conversational tone. Strong in English and many other common languages.

facets.label: IN PLAIN ENGLISH
facets.text: Type or talk the way you would to a coworker or a friend.

facets.label: ANTHROPIC'S EXAMPLE
facets.text: "How do I hang a picture frame in my room?"

facets.label: WHERE
facets.text: claude.ai, the desktop app or the phone app, on one account.

facets.label: IT ANSWERS
facets.text: A quick question gets a quick answer. Then ask follow-ups.

facets.label: IT DOES THE WORK
facets.text: Describe the outcome. It searches, reads your files, runs code and hands back files.

facets.label: WHOLE TASKS
facets.text: On paid plans, longer tasks keep running in the cloud.
